svg.text: SHARDFALL · M13 FUN TEST · OBSERVER SHEET
15 min · fresh save · 3–6 friends · NOBODY EXPLAINS ANYTHING · don't touch their device
A · FIRST 2 MINUTES: write m:ss when it happens
B · STUCK POINTS: write code + m:ss (add R if you hinted). Stuck = 15 s no progress, “what do I do?”, same menu 3×
Hint only after 60 s, one line max. R before 2:00 still counts as stuck.
Stuck codes + times (e.g. S4 1:12 R S8 9:40)
C · 2+ RUNS TALLY: run starts when they enter the gate. Run 2 counts only if NOT asked.
Friends with 2+ unprompted runs ____ / ____ → more than half? ☐ yes ☐ no
☐ starts a run with a friend
GO / NO-GO (all three must be yes)
☐ Kevin wants to keep playing after 15 min
☐ Most friends (> half) did 2+ runs without being asked
☐ Nobody stuck in the first 2 min (no S-code or R before 2:00)
Before: #434 run smoke green, #436 visual QA done, LaunchGate as shipped. After: photo this page → Agent Board (to Ghost). docs/design/m13-observer-sheet
